$comment: Phase 0 — categories.json. Shape matches src/types/categories.ts (CategoryTypeConfig). Comment keys ("//…") are docs only.
//version: Schema/format version for this categories document. Integer >= 1.
//categories: Concrete categories keyed by id. Each value matches CategoryTypeConfig.

cafe.//id: Stable category id (same as the object key). Referenced by categorized markers.
cafe.//name: Human-readable label in legend, filters, and popups.
cafe.name: Cafe
cafe.//type: Fixed enum: "pinned" | "custom" | "categorized". Which marker family this category styles.
cafe.//priority: Optional. Integer >= 0. Default 0. Higher wins when markers are close.
cafe.//viewColor: Optional. Map/view pin or border color (CSS hex).
cafe.//viewIcon: Optional. Emoji or short icon for map/view when not using a picture.
cafe.//viewPicture: Optional. Image URL/path for map/view art.
cafe.//viewPriority: Optional. Integer >= 0. Draw/stack priority on the map view.
cafe.//categoryListIcon: Optional. Icon for legend / category list UI.
cafe.//categoryListPicture: Optional. Image URL/path for legend / category list UI.

categories.//museum: Example categorized category with list/view images.
